commit_message: Route ParticleEmitter through ADR 0125 VFX runtime
pr_body: Implements ADR 0125 in staged commits. This stage removes the legacy ParticleEmitter's parallel RNG/simulator and compiles its convenience fields into the same CompiledVfxEffect/VfxInstance CPU reference path used by authored VFX. Stable source/module/key IDs keep recompilation deterministic and live pools reconfigure in place; the existing mesh render adapter remains API-compatible.
